title: PROTECTION WARRIOR

source.author: Mobalytics-Oli
source.name: Mobalytics WoW Forever · Warrior Leveling Guide (Level 1-30)

headline: Protection from level 16: Revenge and Shield Slam hit hard, and Shield Specialization plus Master of Defense keep the Rage flowing.

build.early: Levels 10-15: take Improved Rend (3/3), then Cruelty (3/5). At 16 you learn Shield Block: respec into Protection (1 silver).

why.Shield Specialization: Block chance, and Rage whenever you block.
why.Improved Revenge: Revenge becomes the main damage button.
why.Vanguard: Charge from Defensive Stance without dumping your Rage.
why.Improved Sunder Armor: Your core threat skill costs less.

core.t: Cast it whenever it procs; it is the main damage skill from 16.
Use on cooldown, just before enemies hit you, to enable Revenge.
Keep stacking it until the target is around 50% HP (5 stacks on elites).
Keep it up at all times.
Use before the kill buff expires, but skip it above 90% HP.

items.t: on cooldown, unless you must save the Rage
until the target is near 50% HP
from Battle Stance, unless you are already close
on hard fights, always on multiple enemies
on hard fights or several enemies

notes: Rage is the resource: you are far stronger at 50 Rage than at 0, so hop from fight to fight without dropping to zero.
Warriors are weak against several enemies until Protection with decent gear: hit one or two and Hamstring-kite the rest.
Take First Aid and keep levelling it; Victory Rush only triggers after a kill, so bandages cover the gaps.
Train weapon skill on low-level mobs when you pick up a new weapon type: weapon skill is your chance to hit.

stats.t: 2 Attack Power per point; boosts most of your damage.
Big health regeneration and damage uptime. Usually first, but Protection is tanky enough that it matters less.

gear: Upgrade your weapon whenever you can: it is the biggest lever for a Warrior.
Prefer faster weapons in Protection: Revenge and Shield Slam do not scale with weapon damage.
Take Blacksmithing and always use Sharpening Stones (free damage; faster weapons benefit more).
Sword and shield are the default setup for Protection.
dungeon_tips: Highest threat: Revenge, Sunder Armor, Heroic Strike / Cleave, Rend, Thunder Clap (higher on groups).
Pull casters around a corner so they run into melee, or open with your ranged weapon on tricky pulls.
Charge in and keep walking when you are speed-running a dungeon.
Sunder bosses to 5 stacks. Demoralizing Shout currently gives no threat, so do not open with it.

alliance.note: Elune's Light is one of the strongest PvE cooldowns; Quickness helps with travel.
Escape Artist for PvP, Eureka! for burst, Engineering Specialization.
Will to Survive breaks stuns; Sword Specialization is +2% crit with swords.

horde.note: Best overall: Blood Fury and Axe Specialization plus Hardiness and Shatter Curse.
Touch of the Grave is great for Fury and for leveling; Will of the Forsaken overlaps Berserker Rage.
Berserking is a good cooldown and Regeneration is great for leveling.

races.pick: If you want one per faction: Night Elf or Gnome, and Orc or Undead.

professions.note: Bandages heal between fights; keep levelling it.
Solid for Warriors and nearly mandatory in PvP.
